newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts oil services firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts oil services firms.

text.p: UBS Securities said analyst Wesley Maat initiated coverage of several oil services companies.
-- said starts the following companies with strong buy ratings: Ensco International Inc, Reading & Bates Corp, Rowan Cos Inc and Transocean Offshore Inc.

-- said started the following companies with buy ratings: Baker Hughes Inc, BJ Services Co, Cliffs Drilling Co, Diamond Offshore Drilling Inc, Falcon Drilling Co Inc, Global Marine Inc, Halliburton Co, Input/Output Inc, Marine Drilling Cos Inc, Noble Drilling Corp, Cooper Cameron Corp, Petroleum Geo, Santa Fe International Corp, Western Atlas Inc and Weatherford Enterra Inc.
-- said started Schlumberger Ltd as a hold.
-- said believes impressive recovery in oil services will continue through 1998, providing strong double-digit earnings comparison into 1998.
-- bullish earnings outlook based on assumption that oil company sending budgets will increase an estimated 15-16 percent in 1997-98.
-- also based on the assumption that the expansion of rig counts "will continue to keep key equipment & services and rig contractors at effective full utilization."
